items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: The interviewee Ernest McLean does not speak in the provided transcript. The interviewer mentions 'Ricard' in the context of identifying people in a photo ('Ricard's wearing the white hat...'), but there is no evidence of a personal relationship or direct interaction between the interviewee and Rica

ctx.x: And Henry Russ, that's why I couldn't call his name. Yeah, that was all I know. Henry Russ and Ricard. Yes, yeah. And Ricard, Ricard, Gilbert Young. Ricard was playing trumpet. And Kid Shots.
Ricard's wearing the white hat right by the palm tree. I think I can get another copy of that picture somewhere. Yeah, that's fine. Yeah, well, it's George. That's a good one.
